questions: Should the function follow redirects automatically (mechanize's default behavior) or handle them in a specific way?
Does 'including those from nested frames' mean recursively fetching frame/iframe src URLs and extracting links from those documents, or just parsing the initial HTML for frame tags?
Should the function handle JavaScript-generated links (which mechanize/BeautifulSoup won't see) or only static HTML?
Should duplicate links be removed, or should all occurrences be included in the list?
Should the order of links in the output list match the order they appear in the HTML document?
Are links from other tags with href attributes (like <link>, <area>, <base>) also included, or only <a> tags?
Should malformed URLs (e.g., containing spaces or invalid characters) be filtered out, or included as-is?
Should the function handle authentication or cookies if required to access the URL?
